SELECT 
  contract_address,
  contract_name,
  network,
  abi,
  events_to_monitor,
  alert_conditions,
  last_block_checked
FROM monitored_contracts
WHERE active = true;

INSERT INTO contract_alerts (
  alert_id,
  contract_address,
  contract_name,
  network,
  events_detected,
  risk_level,
  priority,
  notable_events,
  ai_analysis,
  raw_events
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.alert_id }}',
  '{{ $json.contract.address }}',
  '{{ $json.contract.name }}',
  '{{ $json.contract.network }}',
  {{ $json.events_summary.total_events }},
  '{{ $json.risk_level }}',
  '{{ $json.priority }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.notable_events) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_analysis) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.raw_events) }}'
) RETURNING *;

UPDATE monitored_contracts 
SET last_block_checked = {{ $json.latest_block }},
    last_check_timestamp = NOW()
WHERE contract_address = '{{ $json.contract.address }}';
